name: Finishing
description: Drive in not knowing how it ends. The call names the finish as you gather.
setup: Attack the rim from the wing or the slot with a live dribble. Start the drive during the countdown - the call hits at your gather, so you pick the finish in the air, not before you leave.

calls.read: Cross under, finish the far side.
calls.cue: Help steps up on the ball side.

calls.read: Same foot same hand, high off the glass.
Two steps across his body, finish away.
Inside hand, hang, finish late off the wrong foot.
Pull it early, float over the front rim.
calls.cue: Big is sitting in the paint.

calls.read: Full extension off one foot, reach past him.
Go up, hold it, finish after he lands.
Give it up - hit the corner chair.
calls.cue: Two bodies commit to the ball.

name: Catch and Shoot
description: Catch not knowing which shot it is. The call lands as the ball hits your hands.
setup: Self-toss or spin-out to a spot beyond the arc. Move into the catch during the countdown - hop, back pedal, or off a curl. The call hits on the catch.

calls.read: Straight up, ball never drops below the pocket.
Shot fake, sidestep to space, shoot.
Shot fake, one dribble, pull up.
Jab him back, rise into it.
Rip through, one dribble, get to your shot.
Give it up, relocate one spot, catch and shoot again.

name: Handling
description: Attack not knowing which counter. The call names the move once you are already moving.
setup: Cone as the defender. Start your attack during the countdown with a live dribble at speed. The call hits one stride before you reach him.

calls.read: Killer cross into the burnsey, finish.
In and out into the space behind him, go by.
calls.cue: He is heavy on your strong side.

calls.read: Reverse through into the euro.
calls.cue: He beats you to the spot.

calls.read: Misdirection through or behind, go the other way.
Lowman, stay low, get skinny past him.
Snatch it back, reattack the same side.
Kill the dribble, get into your shot.
calls.cue: He goes under and gives you space.

name: On Ball
description: Contain. Beat him to the spot, never to the man.
setup: Two cones marking the lanes he can attack. Start in stance a mirror-distance off a third cone as the handler. The call hits as he goes.

calls.read: Beat him to the spot, hip to hip, no rise.
Beat him to the spot, hip to hip, no rise.
He crosses back. Change direction without your hips coming up.
Do not bite. Stay down, hold the gap.
He snatches back for the shot. Close the space, high hand.
You are beat. Open the hip, run, re-plant in front.

name: Ball Screen D
description: Your coverage is set before the rep. The call is what he does with the screen.
setup: Cone as the screener at the slot, second cone as the handler. Pick your coverage before each round - over, under or ice - and say it out loud. Come into the screen during the countdown.

calls.read: Fight over, get skinny, re-attach at his hip before he turns the corner.
He rejects it. Beat him back the other way - there is no screen to fight.
He snakes back middle. Cross over the top and re-attach on the new side.
Do not get split. Take the middle away, force him to one side.
calls.cue: He splits the two of you.

calls.read: He pulls up behind it. Close the gap, high hand, do not foul.
He comes back to it. Reset the coverage, do not trail.

name: Transition D
description: Sprint back and know who you have before you arrive.
setup: Start at the offensive block. Two markers at the far end - one wide, one at the rim. Sprint back during the countdown. The call is what you have to take.

calls.read: Pick up the ball. Nobody else is going to.
Protect the rim first. Build the wall, take the kick later.
Take the deepest man, then match on the next pass.
Everyone is back. Find your man and match.
The trailer is the threat. Meet him above the break.

name: Recover and Slide
description: Reactive change of direction from a defensive shape. Your legs are already committed somewhere else when the call lands.
setup: Start in help. Slide one direction, touch the floor, sprint back to your spot. The call hits as you arrive - go the way it says.

calls.read: Slide left with him.
Slide right with him.
He goes behind you left - open the hip, run, re-plant in front.
He goes behind you right - open the hip, run, re-plant in front.
